notes.title: V5.0.1f PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557171/bd29c077760f3f6318acb5d09ba331cbbc9ae3fb.jpg[/img]

· The image of the button displayed on the screen at battle is now selectable from PS, Xbox and keyboard.
  * Change the display from the signboard of the dungeon entrance.
· Mushroom quiz's question no longer overlap. (Mushroom fairy has become smarter)
· The number of mushrooms you can get with the quiz 's reward has been reduced to 1 per type.
· The quiz is now finished as soon as the quiz is incorrect.
· SE volume adjustment in part
· Other minor modifications.
